title: SP3 Proteomics Mass Spec Sample Prep
author: Opentrons
materials: Upload your protocol into the OT App.

steps.title: Load reagents into plate
steps.instruction: Place the reagent plate in slot 5 and fill columns as follows: column 1 with DTT, column 2 with CAA, column 3 with magnetic bead stock, columns 4‑5 with ABC, and column 6 with trypsin.

steps.title: Load wash plates
steps.instruction: Place the ethanol plate in slot 2 and the acetonitrile plate in slot 3.

steps.title: Perform reduction and alkylation
steps.instruction: Using the Opentrons OT‑2, add DTT from column 1 and CAA from column 2 to each sample well, then incubate as required for reduction and alkylation.

steps.title: Bind proteins to magnetic beads
steps.instruction: Add magnetic bead stock from column 3 and ABC buffer from columns 4‑5 to each sample well to allow protein binding to the beads.

steps.title: Wash beads with ethanol
steps.instruction: Transfer ethanol from the plate in slot 2 to the bead‑bound samples and perform the ethanol wash step.

steps.title: Wash beads with acetonitrile
steps.instruction: Transfer acetonitrile from the plate in slot 3 to the bead‑bound samples and perform the acetonitrile wash step.

steps.title: On‑bead digestion
steps.instruction: Add trypsin from column 6 to each sample well and incubate to digest proteins while still bound to the beads.

steps.title: Set up Opentrons deck
steps.instruction: Arrange the deck according to the provided deck map, placing tip racks, the reagent plate, ethanol plate, acetonitrile plate, and any required labware in their designated slots.

steps.title: Calibrate labware and pipettes
steps.instruction: Using the OT App, calibrate all labware, tip racks, and the P20 GEN2 and P300 GEN2 single‑channel pipettes with the appropriate calibration tips.

steps.title: Upload and run protocol
steps.instruction: Download the protocol file, upload it into the OT App, then press “Run” to execute the automated steps. Change tip racks or move labware during the run if prompted due to limited deck space.
